alkylation_reagent: Then, samples were alkylated by 20 mM Iodacetamide for 20 min in the dark
cleavage_agent: Islets for the proteomics workflow were lysed, reduced, and pre-digested in 10 µl lysis buffer (6 M Urea, 2 M Thiourea, and 10 mM DTT) (Sigma) and 1 µg Lys-C (Wako) supplemented with PhosSTOP phosphatase inhibitor (Roche) for 2 h at RT.
collision_energy: The most abundant peptide ions were selected from the MS for higher energy collision-induced dissociation (HCD) fragmentation (normalized collision energy: 40 V).
fractionation_method: The peptide samples were subjected to fractionation using HILIC.
fragmentation_method: The most abundant peptide ions were selected from the MS for higher energy collision-induced dissociation (HCD) fragmentation (normalized collision energy: 40 V).
instrument: The nanoLC was online connected to an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos (Thermo Fisher Scientific) operated at positive ion mode with a data-dependent acquisition.
labeling: A total of 100 µg tryptic peptides from each sample were labeled with TMT10 plex according to the manufacture’s protocol
mass_analyzer: The Lumos acquired the full MS scan with an automatic gain control (AGC) target value of 1 × 106 ions and a maximum fill time of 50 ms. Each MS scan was acquired at high resolution (120,000 full-width half maximum (FWHM)) at m/z 200 in the Orbitrap with a mass range of 400–1600 Da.
ptm: fixed modifications, TMT6plex (N-terminal), TMT6plex (K) and Carbamidomethyl (C).
